selected_problem: Fresh canonical main recorded applyReceipt.receiptSha256 over applyReceipt.files, and rollback trusted applyReceipt.files to recover expected identity/mode metadata, but rollback never checked that the persisted files array still matched its receipt hash. A stale or tampered durable apply receipt could therefore silently weaken rollback conflict detection even though the receipt already carried an integrity field intended to bind that file list.
decision_basis: This closes an already-existing receipt self-consistency invariant rather than choosing a new persistence, signature, trust-root, UI, or product architecture.
The regression is directly falsifiable on fresh main by changing applyReceipt.files while leaving receiptSha256 unchanged: rollback previously proceeded instead of rejecting the inconsistent receipt.

Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502, so this cycle used DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and exact local focused validation rather than claiming a hosted DWAC execution receipt.

pre_fix_reality.source_observation: ChangesetStore.apply persisted applyReceipt={at,files,receiptSha256}, while ChangesetStore.rollback constructed appliedByPath directly from doc.applyReceipt.files without checking receiptSha256.
pre_fix_reality.focused_reproduction: Changing the persisted apply receipt file path while retaining the original receiptSha256 caused the pre-fix rollback path to complete instead of rejecting the inconsistent receipt.
pre_fix_reality.impact: receipt-protected post-apply identity/mode evidence could be silently altered or dropped before rollback preflight

change: Rollback now verifies that applyReceipt.files exists and that sha256(JSON.stringify(files)) equals applyReceipt.receiptSha256 before deriving any rollback preflight expectations from the receipt. A mismatch fails closed with CHANGESET_APPLY_RECEIPT_CORRUPT before restoration.

validation.pre_fix_regression: EXPECTED_FAILURE: new regression reported Missing expected exception on fresh-main source, proving the inconsistent apply receipt was accepted
validation.node_check: PASS on the exact proposed core/changesets.mjs content
validation.intact_receipt_regression: PASS: an unchanged apply receipt still permits rollback to the exact original bytes

truth_boundary: This verifies apply-receipt self-consistency against the receipt hash before rollback consumes receipt metadata. It is not an authenticated signature or trust root and does not claim protection against a coherent malicious rewrite of both receipt files and receiptSha256.
